sentences.text: Sanjuansaurus was about the size of a medium Herrerasaurus, possessing a femur 395 mm long and a tibia 360 mm long.
The pubis of Sanjuansaurus points toward the cranium, a feature unlike that seen in other herrerasaurids.
This pubis is relatively short, measuring 63% of the femur length, and bears a pronounced rugose scar on the medial surface of the femur at the fourth trochanter.

Its skeleton includes shelf-like transverse processes on cervical vertebrae, acute anterior and posterior processes on the sixth to eighth dorsal neural spines, and everted lateral margins on the glenoid.
The holotype skeleton of Sanjuansaurus was discovered in 1994 in Ischigualasto Provincial Park, San Juan, Argentina.
Oscar Alcober and Ricardo Martinez named and described the species in 2010 based on this find.
The species S. gordilloi was named in honor of Raúl Gordillo, the main fossil preparator and artist at the San Juan Museum.
Phylogenetic analysis classifies Sanjuansaurus as a herrerasaurid dinosaur.
It belongs to the class Saurischia, the group containing long-tailed dinosaurs.
The paleoenvironment of the Ischigualasto Formation was a volcanically active alluvial plain covered by forests and subject to heavy seasonal rains.
Sanjuansaurus lived alongside early dinosaurs such as Eoraptor, Herrerasaurus, Chromogisaurus, and Panphagia.
Fossil evidence dates Sanjuansaurus to approximately 231.4 million years ago during the late Carnian Stage.
However, the time range for Sanjuansaurus is from 237 to 227.3 million years ago.
